ticket.title: Total Hours is displayed inconsistently in Month View

scope: Bug: in Attendance > My attendance > Month view the toolbar stats (Scheduled/Total/Absence hours) must aggregate the whole displayed month, not the active ISO week, so June 2026 shows one stable value. Read-only run with the xiontechs account (no attendance records on dev, so a non-zero Total hours such as 55 cannot be reproduced).

cases.title: Month view stats cover the whole displayed month (Oct 2026)

steps.action: Open Attendance, switch View to Month view (Oct 2026); compare with week view where Scheduled hours was 40
steps.expected: Month view shows 'October 2026' and 'Scheduled hours: 176' (whole month, not the week's 40)

cases.title: June 2026 month stats are stable regardless of week anchor
cases.notes: Month view read three times: direct (160/0/160), after Week view 1-7 Jun (160/0/160), after Week view 15-21 Jun (160/0/160)

steps.action: Month view June 2026; switch to Week view, move to 15-21 Jun, switch back to Month view
steps.expected: Header 'June 2026' with 'Scheduled hours: 160' and 'Total hours: 0', identical every time

cases.title: Non-zero Total hours (the reported 55) matches across views
cases.preconditions: Employee with attendance records in June 2026
cases.notes: The xiontechs account has no attendance records on dev (Total hours 0 in every week and month), so the original 0 vs 55 symptom cannot be reproduced or disproved. Needs an account with June 2026 attendance data.

steps.action: Month view June 2026 vs week views
steps.expected: Total hours equals sum of the weeks

observations: Header shows employee 'Amol R Bhangale' (Staff ID 20065716) while the signed-in account is danh.nguyen@xiontechs.com; presumably dev admin context, not verified.
